welcome.title: Welcome to Zitto e Corri
welcome.intro: Your running coach, always in your pocket. It takes a couple of minutes to set it up for you; you can change everything later in settings.

coach.title: AI coach
coach.text: A chat with a coach that knows your training and suggests changes to your plan, always for you to approve.

plan.title: A plan that fits you
plan.text: Fourteen days of workouts that adapt to how you feel and to the weather.

runs.title: Runs and progress
runs.text: Import your runs from files or your watch: analysis, fitness, predictions and records.

watch.title: Your watch
watch.text: Sleep and recovery data come from your watch, and the plan goes back to it as guided workouts.

profile.title: Let's get to know you
profile.intro: This data makes zones and suggestions reliable. Leave blank anything you don't know.

goal.title: What do you want to achieve?
goal.intro: You don't need a race: wanting to run better is enough. You can change it anytime.

race.title: Train for a race
race.text: You have a date: the plan builds up to that day.

improve.title: Improve over a distance
improve.text: No race in sight: you're working on running better over 5 km, 10 km…

none.title: Just train
none.text: No goal for now. You can add one whenever you like.

ai.title: Turn on the AI coach
ai.intro: Choose which service powers it. You need your own key; you can skip and add it later, but the coach stays off until then.
ai.geminiHint: The simplest choice: a key from Google AI Studio.
ai.geminiLink: Create a key in Google AI Studio ↗
ai.openrouterHint: One key for hundreds of models (Claude, GPT, DeepSeek…), pay as you go; some are free.
ai.modelPlaceholder: Or type the id, e.g. openai/gpt-5-mini
ai.later: Later you can switch service and pick different models for chat and analysis in Settings → Coach.

watch.title: Your watch
watch.intro: With a watch connected, the coach sees your sleep, recovery and resting heart rate, and the plan reaches your wrist. It's optional.

amazfit.name: Amazfit
amazfit.text: Balance 2 and Active 3 Premium. Runs and health data come from Intervals.icu, and the plan goes back to the watch as guided workouts. The dedicated Zepp app also adds fitness data and, on the Balance 2, the “Today” widget (requires Zepp developer mode).

others.name: Garmin and other watches
others.text: Meanwhile you can import your runs from FIT or GPX files, from any watch.

watch.where: You connect it from Settings → Connections.
